regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your recent favor - duly received and noted. Rev. Fr. Provincial - Fr. Clement evidently appreciated your generous offer to help educate clerics, etc. for the Holy Priesthood. He was unexpectedly called to Rome about the time. An appreciative letter seemed to be about all he could send me in this regard. He hoped at his conclusion to get in touch with you later on. I was surprised - not unpleasantly - at my transfer hither to St. Felix. Only about 90 miles from Chicago. So I'll be expecting to see you some of these fine coming Nay days.
